title: ProcessedTextRecord
description: Output of TLP/NLP processing for a single document chunk. Unit of storage in Chroma. One record per chunk per document.

record_id.description: Stable unique identifier for this chunk record. Format: {doc_id}::{chunk_index}.

chunk_index.description: Zero-based chunk position within the document.

embedding_text.description: The string passed to the embedding model. This is a domain-normalized, NLP-condensed summary of the chunk — NOT the raw text. Constructed from: extracted entities + causal statements + normalized failure mode labels + key measurements. Optimized for semantic retrieval against RCA queries.

raw_text_excerpt.description: Short verbatim excerpt from the source chunk (max 500 chars) for human grounding during review. Not embedded.

raw_text_ref.description: Pointer to raw source storage (file path, S3 URI, or document store ID). Raw text is not stored in Chroma.

section_path.description: Hierarchical section path within the document (e.g., '3.2.1 Corrective Actions'). Enables traceback to source section.

metadata.description: Typed Chroma metadata fields. All fields here are available as hard pre-filters before semantic ranking.

asset_ids.description: Canonical asset IDs mentioned in this chunk. Used for hard asset-scoping filter in evidence retrieval.

component_ids.description: Canonical component IDs from MBSE model identified in this chunk.

fm_ids.description: Failure mode IDs (from FMEA/KG) resolved from extracted failure mode keywords.

authority_level.description: Inherited from parent document. Used to weight evidence in scoring.

extraction_quality.description: NLP/OCR confidence for this chunk. Chunks below config.min_extraction_quality are excluded from retrieval.

pii_masked.description: Must be true before embedding or LLM use.

extracted_entities.description: Structured NLP entity extraction output. Feeds KG node creation and embedding_text construction.

assets.description: Plant assets identified in the chunk.

surface_form.description: Text as it appears in the source (e.g., 'pump 101', 'P-101A').

canonical_id.description: Resolved canonical asset_id after entity resolution.

failure_modes.description: Failure mode or degradation phenomena identified. Normalized against FMEA taxonomy.

degradation_phenomena.description: Degradation mechanisms mentioned (e.g., corrosion, fatigue, wear). From nuclear entity dictionary.

measurements.description: Numeric values with units extracted from text (e.g., '92.3 degC', 'ISO VG 68').

in_spec.description: Compared against engineering limits if resolvable.

maintenance_actions.description: Maintenance operations, tools, and treatments identified.

temporal_markers.description: Temporal expressions extracted from text that characterize event timing.

resolved_timestamp.description: If resolvable to an absolute timestamp.

extracted_causal_statements.description: Causal language extracted by NLP. Each entry represents a directional causal claim found in the text. Seeds causal candidate generation and TSKR corpus.

statement.description: Full extracted sentence containing causal language.

causal_connectors.description: Trigger words found: 'caused by', 'resulted in', 'due to', 'following', 'led to'.

cause_fm_id.description: Resolved FM ID of cause entity, if resolvable.

effect_fm_id.description: Resolved FM ID of effect entity, if resolvable.

condition_assessment.description: Structured as-found / as-left condition extracted from WO or CR text.

source_hash.description: Hash of the raw source chunk for incremental re-processing detection.

entity_resolution_version.description: Version of the entity resolution layer used to map surface forms to canonical IDs.
